item.title: GTA VI Takes Over Thanksgiving Week
item.description: [Bloomberg] On Bloomberg This Weekend, Bloomberg reporter Josyana Joshua tells host Lisa Mateo how the long-awaited release of Grand Theft Auto VI is becoming a cultural and workplace phenomenon, with gamers taking time off and preparing to play through Thanksgiving week. Joshua explains how the game’s 13-year buildup is driving demand for consoles and gaming gear while potentially competing with family gatherings, football and other holiday entertainment. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Fed’s Inflation Fight May Require More Hikes
item.description: [Bloomberg] Neil Dutta, head of US economic research at Renaissance Macro Research, tells Bloomberg This Weekend that the Federal Reserve made a mistake by holding rates steady in October and may need multiple hikes as inflation remains stubbornly above its 2% target. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Dutta says the recent market selloff does not yet signal broader economic trouble, arguing that AI investment and a resilient labor market continue to support growth even as the Fed has less flexibility to cushion falling markets. (Source: Bloomberg)
